observed_behavior: The resumed native worker truthfully reported its refreshed base and retained out-of-lease unfinished work, but the test failed because its final message omitted the generation ID.
expected_behavior: A retained dirty worker can resume responsibility and report a blocker without claiming successful clean submission or discarding its checkpoint.
causal_mechanism: The fixture treated an incidental generation substring in a freeform blocker report as a required acknowledgement, although generation and identity are established by the durable resumption and dispatch receipts.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A phase-specific integration assertion imposes a success-message convention on a valid blocked outcome.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Correct preservation and refusal are reported as a failure because permitted human-readable diagnostics omit an unrelated token.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Resumption proof distinguishes restored responsibility from discharge and retains dirty work without manufacturing clean proof.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Keep exact session, generation, lease, dispatch and persisted resumption checks; verify the actual refreshed-base and protected-path blocker facts, reject a successful submission interpretation, and assert the original HEAD and unfinished file remain unchanged.

applicability_conditions: A native lifecycle Arc intentionally retains dirty out-of-lease work.
The worker is permitted to report a blocker rather than submit successful structured proof.
known_non_matches: A successful clean no-edit obligation must still submit exact physical V1 JSON.
confirmation_evidence: The twelve-case native Suite passed eleven cases and failed only the generation substring assertion.
Reading the exact retained native turn showed a correct refreshed-base and unfinished.ts blocker report.
The corrected focused native resumption Arc passed with zero skips or cancellations and preserved the original owner and checkout.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live worker resumption restores its original native session with refreshed scope and campaign base
tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: native resumed blocker facts and unchanged HEAD assertions
